title: Microsoft secures structural wins in OpenAI revenue cap deal, Wedbush says
title_zh: Wedbush 表示，微软在 OpenAI 收入上限协议中获得了结构性胜利
summary: OpenAI has agreed to cap the total revenue it shares with Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) at $38 billion through 2030, down sharply from a prior arrangement that could have generated as much as $135 billion in cumulative payments for the software giant, according to people famili...
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，OpenAI 已同意将其与微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）分享的总收入上限限制在 2030 年之前的 380 亿美元，这比之前的安排大幅下降，此前的安排可能为这家软件巨头带来高达 1350 亿美元的累计付款。
